notes: «قال ابن شهاب» opens the report with no earlier transmitter in the text, so Zuhri is the single link at its head (rule 10).
«فأخبرني من، سمع جابر بن عبد الله» leaves the informant unnamed (rule 8): an unnamed link between Zuhri and Jabir. Jabir's own account («فكنت فيمن رجمه») is the saying.
